Memory Capacity: Up to 32GB Unbuffered non-ECC SO-DIMM, DDR4-2133MHz, in 2 DIMM slots

Network Controllers: Single LAN with Intel® PHY I219LM

COM Port: 2 RS232, 2 RS232/422/485, RS-485 supports auto flow control

PCI-Express: 1 Full size Mini-PCIe (1 USB 2.0, 1 PCIe Gen2, 1 SATA Gen3)
M.2: Interface: SATA and PCIe 3.0 x1 and USB 2.0

Internal: 1 M.2 2280 B-Key for SATA or PCIe SSD

Power Configurations: Control of power-on for recovery from AC power loss
CPU thermal trip support for processor protection

Operating Temperature: 0°C ~ 50°C (32°F ~ 122°F) with 0.7 m/s air flow
Non-operating Relative Humidity: 5% to 95% (non-condensing) The use of industrial grade wide-temperature peripherals is required to meet 50°C operating temperature.
